title_original: ‘The Really Loud House’ Actress Catherine Ashmore Bradley & ‘The Boys’ Actor Cameron Crovetti Lead Horror ‘Dollkeeper’
excerpt_original: EXCLUSIVE: Catherine Ashmore Bradley, best known for playing Luan Loud in Nickelodeon and Paramount+’s The Really Loud House, will star as Sara in the psychological horror feature Dollkeeper. Cameron Crovetti (The Boys, Goodnight Mommy) will star as her older brother Dylan.…

blocks.text: EXCLUSIVE : Catherine Ashmore Bradley, best known for playing Luan Loud in Nickelodeon and Paramount+’s The Really Loud House , will star as Sara in the psychological horror feature Dollkeeper .

Cameron Crovetti ( The Boys , Goodnight Mommy ) will star as her older brother Dylan. Additional casting is in process. Principal photography is set to begin in the coming weeks in Fort Lauderdale, Florida.

blocks.text: Plot details are being kept under wraps, but the team says the psychological horror “follows a teenage girl confronting a terrifying figure connected to her family’s past”.
The film is produced by Stephen Henric through Voodoo Pictures. Dominic Easter serves as director of photography.
Casting is by Chloë Curran, whose credits include David Fincher’s The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth , Station 19 , Winning Time: The Rise of the Lakers Dynasty and Quantum Leap .

Henric’s short film Don’t Let It In was licensed by Alter and subsequently adapted into a feature distributed by Fox Entertainment’s MarVista Entertainment. Her follow-up, Unknown , earned the Scariest Short Film Prize at Popcorn Frights.
Bradley is represented by CESD Talent Agency, Rebel Creative Group, and Slash Management. Cameron Crovetti is represented by The Osbrink Agency, Industry Entertainment and GGSSC.
